children: Kforce entered a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan to repurchase its common stock under its board‑authorized buyback program.
Company adopted a corporate stock trading plan on Sept 15, 2026 to execute share repurchases.

Repurchases will be handled by an independent broker and are subject to price, market, volume and timing limits.
